reelection.rule: Rule: next even-year November for this House term. legislators-current.yaml ends the current term on 2027-01-03. The even-year November before that January 3 end is November 2026. The file has no election day, so no day of the month is shown.

vote_frequency.label: In this cached set only (the latest 40 House roll calls, not a lifetime record): 40 of 40. Yea or Aye: 19. Nay or No: 19. Not Voting: 2. Of 38 Yea or Nay votes where the Democratic majority could be computed, 37 (97%) matched that majority (majority = the side most of that party's members voting Yea or Nay took; on average 208 members of that party voted Yea or Nay per roll call).
